title: Defensive restore: a stale saved category or vendor is dropped on load
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report has saved settings in this browser, including a category or vendor selection that can be made stale (for example, the last in-stock part of a saved category is consumed so the category disappears from the data).
steps:
1. Make the saved category or vendor no longer present in the data.
2. Open the Inventory Value report.
expected:
1. The report loads normally — the saved category or vendor that is no longer present in the data is dropped from the selection instead of breaking the view (the defensive-restore rule applied to the path these steps drive).
2. All other saved settings are still restored.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S8-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
